description: Figure 2 presents the distribution of emotion categories as represented by the number of utterances within the IEMOCAP dataset. The pie chart is divided into eight slices, each representing a different emotion category. The slices are labeled “happy,” “sad,” “angry,” “neutral,” “excited,” “frustrated,” “disappointed,” and “surprised.” The colors of the slices are varying shades of blue and green. The “neutral” category occupies the largest proportion of the chart, at approximately 36%, followed by “happy” at roughly 21%. “Sad” represents about 14% of the chart, while “angry” and “excited” each account for approximately 10%. “Frustrated” is around 6%, “disappointed” is approximately 3%, and “surprised” represents about 1% of the total. Percentage labels are displayed directly within each slice. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, generally from largest to smallest proportion. A legend is not present, as the labels are directly on the chart.
